input: Sign up for a local volunteer cleanup event

gold.taskTitle: Sign Up for a Local Volunteer Cleanup Event
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find and register for a volunteer cleanup event happening in their local area.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood are you searching in?
questions.description: Identify the geographic location to narrow down relevant local cleanup events.

questions.title: Do you have a specific environment in mind to clean?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants a beach, park, roadside, river, or urban area cleanup.

questions.title: What date or timeframe works best for you?
questions.description: Establish when the user is available so events can be filtered by schedule.

questions.title: Are you signing up alone or with a group?
questions.description: Clarify whether this is an individual registration or includes friends, family, or colleagues.

questions.title: Have you already found an event or need help locating one?
questions.description: Determine whether the user needs help discovering events or just completing registration.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred organizing body or platform?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a preference for organizations like VolunteerMatch, Meetup, a city program, or a specific nonprofit.

questions.title: Is there a maximum time commitment you are comfortable with?
questions.description: Understand how many hours the user is willing to dedicate so the right event length can be targeted.
